text: Storage Write API (gRPC) offers lower pricing and exactly-once delivery for streaming writes
quote: The Storage Write API (gRPC) has lower pricing and more robust features, including exactly-once delivery semantics.

text: DML statements let you insert, update, and delete data in tables
quote: Data Manipulation Language (DML) statements enable you to update, insert, and delete data from your BigQuery tables.

text: Conversational analytics lets users talk to their data in natural language
quote: 대화형 분석을 사용하면 자연어로 데이터와 대화할 수 있습니다.

text: BigQuery data canvas lets you explore, transform, query, and visualize data in one interface
quote: BigQuery 데이터 캔버스로 데이터 탐색, 변환, 쿼리, 시각화

text: Gemini in BigQuery generates/suggests SQL or Python code and explains existing queries
quote: BigQuery의 Gemini를 사용하여 SQL 또는 Python에서 코드를 생성하거나 제안하고 기존 SQL 쿼리를 설명할 수 있습니다.

text: BigQuery sandbox lets you use BigQuery without a credit card or billing account
quote: Mit der BigQuery-Sandbox können Sie BigQuery nutzen, ohne eine Kreditkarte anzugeben oder ein Rechnungskonto für Ihr Projekt zu erstellen.

text: Dataform lets analysts develop, test, version, and schedule data transformation workflows in BigQuery
quote: Dataform is a service for data analysts to develop, test, control versions, and schedule complex workflows for data transformation in BigQuery.

text: Notebooks combine SQL queries with Python, rich text, and visualizations
quote: notebooks let you combine SQL queries with Python code, rich text, and visualizations to tell a comprehensive story with your data.

text: BigQuery sharing is a data exchange platform for securely sharing and accessing data across organizations without replication
quote: La condivisione di BigQuery (precedentemente Analytics Hub) è una piattaforma di scambio di dati che consente di condividere, scoprire e accedere in modo sicuro ai dati tra i confini organizzativi senza replicarli.

text: Iceberg managed tables give a fully managed experience while storing data in customer-owned storage buckets
quote: Iceberg managed tables offer the same fully managed experience as standard BigQuery tables, but store data in customer-owned storage buckets.

text: Continuous queries are SQL statements that run continuously to analyze incoming data in real time
quote: BigQuery の継続的クエリは、継続的に実行される SQL ステートメントです。継続的クエリを使用すると、BigQuery で受信データをリアルタイムで分析できます。

text: bq is a Python-based CLI tool for creating datasets, loading sample data, and querying tables
quote: vai aprender a usar o `bq`, a ferramenta de interface de linha de comandos (CLI) baseada em Python para o BigQuery, para criar um conjunto de dados, carregar dados de amostra e consultar tabelas.

text: Conversational analytics supports market basket analysis questions
quote: Conversational analytics now supports questions about market basket analysis.

text: A Rust SDK for BigQuery is available in Preview
quote: The Rust SDK for BigQuery is now in Preview.

text: Pipelines can be created, stored, and managed in Git folders
quote: You can now create, store, and manage pipelines in Git folders.

text: Predictive analytics models can be trained, evaluated, and deployed directly in BigQuery using SQL
quote: Train, evaluate, and deploy predictive analytics models directly within BigQuery using SQL.

text: Supports building RAG and context-retrieval applications using vector, text, or hybrid search over embeddings
quote: Build sophisticated context-retrieval and RAG applications with embeddings and vector, text, or hybrid search to find information based on meaning, not just keywords.

text: A Pub/Sub subscription can stream high-throughput data loads into BigQuery as they're generated
quote: To stream data into BigQuery, you can use a BigQuery subscription in Pub/Sub. Pub/Sub can handle high throughput of data loads into BigQuery.

text: On-demand pricing charges per TiB processed, with the first 1 TiB per month free
quote: On-demand pricing (per TiB). With this pricing model, you are charged for the number of bytes processed by each query. The first 1 TiB of query data processed per month is free.

text: Runs analytics over vast amounts of data in near real time using GoogleSQL or Python with no infrastructure to manage
quote: there's no infrastructure to set up or manage, letting you focus on finding meaningful insights using GoogleSQL or Python

text: GoogleSQL is an ANSI-compliant SQL dialect supporting standard query statement types
quote: GoogleSQL is an ANSI-compliant Structured Query Language (SQL) that includes the following types of supported statements

text: Colab Enterprise notebooks support end-to-end data science and ML workflows in one integrated interface
quote: Colab Enterprise notebooks in BigQuery let you perform end-to-end data science and machine learning workflows within a single, integrated interface.

text: Iceberg managed tables support the open Iceberg format for interoperability with open-source and third-party engines
quote: Iceberg managed tables support the open Iceberg table format for better interoperability with open-source and third-party compute engines

text: Predefined IAM roles and permissions are documented for BigQuery resources
quote: In diesem Dokument finden Sie eine Liste der vordefinierten IAM-Rollen (Identity and Access Management) und Berechtigungen für BigQuery.

text: BigQuery sharing lets you discover curated third-party and Google datasets to combine with your own data
quote: Puoi utilizzare BigQuery sharing per scoprire set di dati curati di terze parti e di Google e combinarli con i tuoi dati interni

text: Replication method allows near real-time replication of data from databases into BigQuery
quote: This method enables replicating data from databases to BigQuery in near real time.

text: Gemini lets users find, join, query, visualize, and collaborate on table assets using natural language
quote: BigQuery의 Gemini로 자연어를 사용하여 테이블 애셋을 찾고 조인하고 쿼리하고 결과를 시각화하며 전체 프로세스에서 다른 사용자와 원활하게 공동작업할 수 있습니다.

text: You can view a visualization of a workflow's dependency tree
quote: View a visualization of the dependency tree of your workflow.

text: Load jobs can be scheduled as one-time or recurring batch transfers
quote: you can schedule load jobs. You can schedule one-time or batch data transfers at regular intervals

text: BigQuery ML models can be built, evaluated, and deployed within a single notebook interface
quote: End-to-end ML workflows: build, evaluate, and deploy a BigQuery ML model within a single notebook interface.

text: Time travel enables access to historical data in BigQuery
quote: Time travel for historical data access in BigQuery.

text: BigQuery Graph helps uncover complex relationships and patterns in data
quote: use BigQuery Graph to uncover complex relationships and patterns in your data.

text: Compute capacity can be reserved ahead of time as slots (virtual CPUs)
quote: You can also reserve compute capacity ahead of time in the form of slots, which represent virtual CPUs.

text: The distributed, scalable engine can query terabytes in seconds and petabytes in minutes
quote: the distributed and scalable analysis engine of BigQuery allows querying terabytes in seconds and petabytes in minutes

text: Sandbox lets you explore limited BigQuery capabilities at no cost
quote: The BigQuery sandbox lets you explore limited BigQuery capabilities at no cost to confirm whether BigQuery fits your needs.

text: AI functions support text summarization, sentiment analysis, and data enrichment in workflows
quote: Use generative AI in your workflows with AI functions for text summarization, sentiment analysis, and data enrichment.

text: Simba ODBC and JDBC drivers connect applications and BI tools to BigQuery
quote: The Simba Open Database Connectivity (ODBC) and Java Database Connectivity (JDBC) drivers for BigQuery connect your applications to BigQuery, letting you use BigQuery features with your preferred tooling and infrastructure.

text: Diagnostic query plan and timing information similar to EXPLAIN is available for queries
quote: BigQuery includes diagnostic query plan and timing information. This is similar to the information provided by statements such as EXPLAIN in other database and analytical systems.

text: BigQuery provides uniform access to structured and unstructured data and supports open table formats like Iceberg, Delta, and Hudi
quote: BigQuery provides a uniform way to work with both structured and unstructured data and supports open table formats like Apache Iceberg, Delta, and Apache Hudi.

text: Schema evolution lets you add, drop, and rename table columns
quote: _Schema evolution_, which lets you add, drop, and rename columns to suit your needs.

text: Teams can collaborate on workflow development through Git
quote: Collaborate with team members on workflow development through Git.

text: Custom quotas let you cap daily data processed to manage costs across projects
quote: 複数の BigQuery プロジェクトとユーザーが存在している場合は、カスタム割り当てを要求することで費用を管理できます。この割り当てでは、1 日に処理されるデータ量の上限を指定します。

text: Natural language queries can generate, complete, and summarize code for analysis
quote: 您还可以使用自然语言查询来开始数据分析。如需了解如何生成、补全和总结代码

text: BigQuery is covered by compliance attestations including ISO standards, SOC 1/2/3, and HIPAA support, with downloadable reports
quote: Google Cloud compliance resource center lists BigQuery-covered attestations and certifications including ISO 9001:2015, ISO 22301:2019, ISO 50001:2018, SOC 1/2/3, HIPAA support, and sector/regional programs, with downloadable reports per ce
